TABLE.NAME: multicheckin
TABLE.COMMENT: Defines one attendance occurrence (a session of the activity).

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course id.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of this attendance occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Description of this occurrence, shown to students and teachers. Separate from intro, which is the activity's own introduction and is copied from the template on sync.

FIELD.NAME: descriptionformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Text format of description: FORMAT_HTML (1) for anything written since rich text was offered, FORMAT_PLAIN (2) for rows carried over from the plain-textarea era, which are rendered with their newlines preserved instead of being handed to the HTML filter.

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Session start (the base time T0).

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: Session end time.

FIELD.NAME: lategrace
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds after T0 before a first check-in counts as late.

FIELD.NAME: earlygrace
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds before timeend within which no checkout => early leave.

FIELD.NAME: absentreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Reason for absence.

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Max grade (0 = no grade).

FIELD.NAME: pointspresent
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status P (present).

FIELD.NAME: pointslate
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status L (late).

FIELD.NAME: pointsearly
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status EL (left early).

FIELD.NAME: pointslateearly
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status LT (late and left early).

FIELD.NAME: pointsabsent
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status A (absent).

FIELD.NAME: pointsleave
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw points for the final status LV (on leave).

FIELD.NAME: earlymode
FIELD.COMMENT: Early-leave judgement mode: window|threshold.

FIELD.NAME: allowselfcheckin
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = students may check in by themselves.

FIELD.NAME: qronly
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = every point of this occurrence accepts QR check-ins only: the self and password paths are closed. Stricter than allowselfcheckin, which only hides the button. Off by default so nothing that already runs changes.

FIELD.NAME: selfcheckinpassword
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional global password for self check-in.

FIELD.NAME: notifyenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = send reminders for upcoming check-in points. Off by default: a check-in that speaks for itself should not start mailing the class until the teacher asks it to.

FIELD.NAME: notifyleadtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds before a point opens to start reminding.

FIELD.NAME: notifyrule
FIELD.COMMENT: Which points send a reminder: chain = the first point always, later points only to students who checked in at the point before them; all = every point; first = only the first point of the occurrence. Unknown values fall back to chain.

FIELD.NAME: qrrotation
FIELD.COMMENT: QR token rotation period in seconds (5-300).

FIELD.NAME: geomode
FIELD.COMMENT: Geofence mode for self check-in: none|ip|gps|both.

FIELD.NAME: geoipranges
FIELD.COMMENT: Allowed client IP/CIDR ranges, one per line.

FIELD.NAME: geolat
FIELD.COMMENT: Classroom centre latitude.

FIELD.NAME: geolng
FIELD.COMMENT: Classroom centre longitude.

FIELD.NAME: georadius
FIELD.COMMENT: Allowed radius in metres.

FIELD.NAME: geoenforceqr
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = also apply the geofence to QR check-ins (the default; a scanned code must satisfy the fence too).

FIELD.NAME: showgeoaudit
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = offer the teacher-facing link to the geofence audit page for this activity.

FIELD.NAME: audience
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated role shortnames whose holders are this activity's participants (the attendance roster). Default 'student'.

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = the activity's configuration template; else the id of the template this occurrence belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: seriesid
FIELD.COMMENT: Groups the occurrences generated in one batch (equals the template id). 0 = template.

FIELD.NAME: seqno
FIELD.COMMENT: Ordinal of this occurrence within its series, for display as 'Occurrence N'.

FIELD.NAME: gradeaggregate
FIELD.COMMENT: How occurrence grades combine into the activity grade: all|sum|best.

FIELD.NAME: gradebestcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of best occurrences kept when gradeaggregate = best.

FIELD.NAME: requiresignout
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the session has an end-of-class check-in; 0 = a successful sign-in is the whole record (no early-leave penalty).

FIELD.NAME: photorequired
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = every check-in in this occurrence must be proved with a photograph taken on the spot (browser camera, no uploads). Off by default so nothing that already runs changes.

FIELD.NAME: timefinalised
FIELD.COMMENT: When the scheduled task last computed this occurrence AFTER it ended; 0 = never. Its only job is to tell 'nobody has settled this yet' apart from 'this was settled an hour ago', so the safety net stops re-doing finished work every hour without ever losing a run that died halfway.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_point
TABLE.COMMENT: Defines the N check-in points belonging to one occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Point name e.g. Sign-in / Mid check / Sign-out.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order; 1 = first check-in point.

FIELD.NAME: openoffset
FIELD.COMMENT: Open time as seconds offset from T0 (negative = before).

FIELD.NAME: closeoffset
FIELD.COMMENT: Close time as seconds offset from T0.

FIELD.NAME: role
FIELD.COMMENT: Role: first|mid|last (drives late/early logic).

FIELD.NAME: required
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = must be checked to avoid absence.

FIELD.NAME: password
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional per-point password.

FIELD.NAME: qrcode
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = show QR code for this point.

FIELD.NAME: qronly
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = this point accepts QR check-ins only. Combined with the occurrence-level flag by qr_manager::only_scan(), which is the single place that decides.

FIELD.NAME: qrcodekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Secret used to sign rotating QR tokens.

FIELD.NAME: qrcodetime
FIELD.COMMENT: Last QR generation time.

FIELD.NAME: notify
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = send a reminder when this point opens.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Raw check-in events (a user may have many per point).

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised multicheckin.id for fast queries.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the check-in was recorded.

FIELD.NAME: ip
FIELD.COMMENT: Client IP (supports IPv6).

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_geo_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit trail of the geofence decision for every self/QR check-in attempt.

FIELD.NAME: geomode
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode that was evaluated.

FIELD.NAME: allowed
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = passed the geofence, 0 = rejected.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Machine reason code, e.g. ip_not_allowed / out_of_range / no_gps.

FIELD.NAME: ip
FIELD.COMMENT: Client IP at attempt time.

FIELD.NAME: latitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Reported latitude (GPS mode).

FIELD.NAME: longitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Reported longitude (GPS mode).

FIELD.NAME: accuracy
FIELD.COMMENT: Reported GPS accuracy in metres.

FIELD.NAME: distance
FIELD.COMMENT: Computed distance to classroom centre, metres.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_result
TABLE.COMMENT: Computed final status per user per occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: statuscode
FIELD.COMMENT: P/L/EL/A (present, late, early-leave, absent).

FIELD.NAME: firstcheckin
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest check-in timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: lastcheckin
FIELD.COMMENT: Latest check-in timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: latemin
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes late (0 if not late).

FIELD.NAME: earlymin
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes left early (0 if not early).

FIELD.NAME: points
FIELD.COMMENT: Points awarded for this occurrence.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_notify
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks which reminder messages have already been sent, to avoid duplicates.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_place
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-wide library of named classroom locations, so a teacher picks a room instead of retyping its coordinates.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name, e.g. 主楼 A301 or 阶梯教室 3.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional note, shown as a hint in the picker.

FIELD.NAME: latitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Classroom centre latitude. Always WGS-84, matching what the browser reports.

FIELD.NAME: longitude
FIELD.COMMENT: Classroom centre longitude.

FIELD.NAME: defaultradius
FIELD.COMMENT: Suggested radius in metres for this room.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who last added or edited this place.

INDEX.NAME: name
INDEX.COMMENT: The picker lists and searches by name.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_leave
TABLE.COMMENT: A student's leave request for one attendance occurrence, plus the teacher's review flag.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: multicheckin.id (the occurrence this leave is for).

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional free-text reason given by whoever raised the leave.

FIELD.NAME: origin
FIELD.COMMENT: student|teacher - who raised this leave.

FIELD.NAME: reviewed
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the teacher has looked at this request. Drives the pending badge.

FIELD.NAME: reviewedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who marked it reviewed (0 = nobody yet).

INDEX.NAME: sessionid-userid
INDEX.COMMENT: One leave per student per occurrence.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_photoreq
TABLE.COMMENT: A student's request to be checked in by hand because the on-the-spot photograph could not be taken, plus the teacher's decision.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: multicheckin.id (the occurrence).

FIELD.NAME: pointid
FIELD.COMMENT: multicheckin_point.id. Per point, not per occurrence: a photograph proves ONE check-in, and a sign-in and a sign-out are two separate proofs.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional free-text reason given by the student when asking for review.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = waiting for the teacher, 1 = approved (checked in by hand), 2 = refused.

FIELD.NAME: reviewedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher who decided (0 = nobody yet).

FIELD.NAME: timereviewed
FIELD.COMMENT: When the decision was taken.

INDEX.NAME: sessionid-pointid-userid
INDEX.COMMENT: One request per student per point.

INDEX.NAME: sessionid-status
INDEX.COMMENT: Speeds up the 'waiting for review' count.

TABLE.NAME: multicheckin_pass
TABLE.COMMENT: A one-shot permission to open the camera for one point, held in the database rather than in the student's session so the same link works in any browser the same student is logged into.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the token in the URL. The token itself is never stored, so a copy of this table yields no working link.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The one person the permit belongs to. Cross-browser reach is only safe because of this column.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: multicheckin.id (the occurrence).

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: self|qr|password - how the student proved who they were, which the fence is judged under at recording time.

FIELD.NAME: clientgeo
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON position that cleared the fence when the permit was issued, so recording can re-run the same verdict.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time after which the permit is refused. The only thing that limits its life.

INDEX.NAME: tokenhash
INDEX.COMMENT: The lookup every request makes, and what stops a token existing twice.

INDEX.NAME: userid-expires
INDEX.COMMENT: Listing and dropping one person's outstanding permits.

INDEX.NAME: sessionid
INDEX.COMMENT: Privacy deletion by occurrence. Deliberately not a foreign key - see the design note for 2.0.23.

INDEX.NAME: expires
INDEX.COMMENT: Scheduled cleanup of permits nobody came back for.
